profiles.name: BACnet/IP
profiles.scope: BVLC Original-Unicast-NPDU, optional routed NPDU addresses; unsegmented Who-Is/I-Am; ReadProperty request/ACK/Error and Reject/server-Abort. Runtime generates only Who-Is and ReadProperty requests; response layouts are complete static descriptions.

profiles.name: Modbus TCP
profiles.scope: Modbus TCP MBAP plus FC01/02/03/04 reads, FC05/06 single writes, FC0F/10 multiple writes; all normal response layouts and generic exception layout; FC0F arbitrary 1..1968 coils including final-byte padding. Complete static profile; no runtime encoder.

profiles.name: IEC 60870-5-104
profiles.scope: IEC104 APCI I/S/U; STARTDT/STOPDT/TESTFR; single-object C_IC_NA_1 global/group interrogation request, positive/negative activation confirmation and termination; COT/CA/IOA widths 2/2/3. Other data ASDUs excluded. Complete static profile; no runtime encoder.

profiles.name: IEC 61850 MMS over TCP
profiles.scope: Complete TPKT/COTP TP0, session/presentation normal-mode association, ACSE AARQ/AARE with embedded MMS initiate, VMD-domain GetNameList, one domain-specific named-variable Read/Write, MMS conclude and ACSE/session release, all successful request/response layouts. BER definite lengths; no runtime encoder.

profiles.name: EtherNet/IP and CIP explicit TCP
profiles.scope: EtherNet/IP TCP RegisterSession success/failure, UnregisterSession (no reply), SendRRData (NullAddress + UnconnectedData), SendUnitData (ConnectedAddress + ConnectedData with UInt16 class-3 sequence), complete GetAttributeSingle Identity Vendor-ID request/response layouts and encapsulation/CIP errors. SendUnitData requires an externally successful ForwardOpen establishing class-3 connection and supplying directional IDs; this model does not establish that prerequisite. Complete static explicit-message profile; no runtime encoder.

profiles.name: OPC UA TCP
profiles.scope: Complete HEL/ACK/ERR/RHE and single-final-chunk UASC SecurityPolicy None Issue OpenSecureChannel request/response, GetEndpoints Discovery request/response, ServiceFault, implementation-profile CloseSecureChannel. Complete UA Binary headers and nested endpoint/token arrays; no Session services or runtime encoder.
